components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact semantic action button with clear disabled and focus-visible states.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--action-primary); color: var(--on-action-primary); font-family: "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--action-primary) 90%, transparent); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity: .5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action with a control border and selected-surface hover.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--control-border)); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font-family: "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-button-outline:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--surface-selected); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-outline:disabled { opacity: .5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Theme-aware frosted content surface with opaque rendering fallbacks.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 24px; background-color: hsl(var(--glass-surface) / var(--glass-surface-alpha)); color: var(--foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 hsl(var(--glass-shadow) / var(--glass-shadow-near-alpha)), 0 12px 28px -6px hsl(var(--glass-shadow) / var(--glass-shadow-alpha)); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--glass-blur)); backdrop-filter: blur(var(--glass-blur)); transition: box-shadow 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease; } .ds-card[data-interactive]:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -6px hsl(var(--glass-shadow) / var(--glass-shadow-alpha)), 0 0 24px var(--glow-primary); } @media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce), (max-width: 767px), (pointer: coarse) and (hover: none), (update: slow) { .ds-card { background-color: hsl(var(--card)); border-color: hsl(var(--border)); -webkit-backdrop-filter: none; backdrop-filter: none; } } @supports not (backdrop-filter: blur(1px)) { .ds-card { background-color: hsl(var(--glass-opaque)); -webkit-backdrop-filter: none; backdrop-filter: none; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-card { transition: none; } }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Full-width semantic field with a shared visible keyboard-focus treatment.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" aria-label="Search packages" placeholder="Search packages" />
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--input-border)); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface-opaque); color: var(--foreground); font-family: "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--foreground-muted); opacity: 1; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .5; }

components.name: Responsive Navigation
components.description: Frosted 64px header and collapsible mobile menu, then a 72px rail that expands to 240px.
components.html: DashboardHosts
components.css: .ds-navigation { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 64px; padding: 0 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(var(--navbar-highlight) / var(--navbar-highlight-alpha)); background-color: hsl(var(--navbar-surface) / var(--navbar-surface-alpha)); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--navbar-blur)); backdrop-filter: blur(var(--navbar-blur)); } .ds-navigation a { display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 12px; color: var(--foreground-muted); font-family: "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 550; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-navigation a:hover, .ds-navigation a[aria-current="page"] { color: hsl(var(--accent-operational)); background: hsl(var(--accent-operational) / .12); } .ds-navigation a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-navigation { position: fixed; inset: 64px auto 0 0; width: 72px; min-height: 0; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; padding: 12px; } .ds-navigation a { justify-content: center; } } @media (min-width: 1280px) { .ds-navigation { width: 240px; padding: 16px; } .ds-navigation a { justify-content: flex-start; } } @media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce), (pointer: coarse), (max-width: 767px) { .ds-navigation { background: hsl(var(--background-secondary)); -webkit-backdrop-filter: none; backdrop-filter: none; } }

components.name: Host Reporting Status
components.description: Semantic reporting-recency pill; state is not a claim of host availability.
components.css: .ds-reporting-status { display: inline-flex; min-height: 32px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-elevated); color: var(--foreground-muted); font-family: "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-reporting-status[data-status="healthy"] { color: var(--status-success); background: var(--status-success-surface); } .ds-reporting-status[data-status="attention"] { color: var(--status-warning); background: var(--status-warning-surface); } .ds-reporting-status-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; flex: none; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Bar Chart Surface
components.description: Glass chart card with semantic axes, dashed grid, and theme-aware series gradients.
components.css: .ds-chart { overflow: hidden; margin: 0; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 24px; background-color: hsl(var(--glass-surface) / var(--glass-surface-alpha)); color: var(--foreground); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--glass-blur)); backdrop-filter: blur(var(--glass-blur)); } .ds-chart figcaption { margin-bottom: 8px; font-family: "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-chart svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: 220px; } .ds-chart-grid { fill: none; stroke: var(--chart-grid); stroke-dasharray: 3 3; } .ds-chart-series { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-chart-series i { width: 24px; height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: hsl(var(--chart-series-1)); } .ds-chart-series i:nth-child(2) { background: hsl(var(--chart-series-2)); } .ds-chart-series i:nth-child(3) { background: hsl(var(--chart-series-3)); } .ds-chart-series i:nth-child(4) { background: hsl(var(--chart-series-4)); } .ds-chart-series i:nth-child(5) { background: hsl(var(--chart-series-5)); } .ds-chart:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce), (max-width: 767px), (pointer: coarse) { .ds-chart { background: hsl(var(--glass-opaque)); -webkit-backdrop-filter: none; backdrop-filter: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Fluxion pairs a restrained infrastructure-console layout with polished, lightly futuristic materials. Inter Variable, a cool navy-and-white foundation, semantic light and dark themes, and a small family of vivid chart colors keep package activity and host reporting easy to scan without making the interface feel sterile.

Frosted surfaces, subtle ambient color and grid, fine borders, and modest motion add depth without obscuring operational content. Status describes package-report recency, not host availability. Dashboard metrics and reporting recency come from existing APIs; visual guidance must not imply unsupported uptime, latency, or period-over-period change.
keyCharacteristics: Calm, high-contrast semantic surfaces in both themes.
Light-touch frost with opaque fallbacks for constrained rendering.
Data-led color and understated, compact navigation.

rules.name: The Source-Labeled Status Rule
rules.body: A status communicates host package-report recency or a defined UI state; never present it as host availability or uptime.

rules.name: The Opaque Escape Hatch Rule
rules.body: Frost and blur are progressive enhancement: preserve semantic content and surface contrast with the existing opaque fallbacks when transparency or rendering support is constrained.

dos: Do keep colors semantic across light and dark themes; use the existing theme variables for surfaces, text, borders, focus, status, and charts.
Do use tabular numerals for dashboard metrics and preserve the chart’s accessible ranked values.
Do keep host reporting language tied to the existing recency state and API-backed data.
Do retain opaque surface fallbacks and honor reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't describe reporting recency as uptime, availability, or host health beyond package reporting.
Don't imply latency, unsupported time comparisons, or operational measurements absent from the APIs.
Don't use chart series colors as a substitute for semantic success, warning, or error states.
Don't add notification-inbox or account-profile UI to this system; those surfaces are deferred.
